_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Inflation diagnostics now identify adaptive pump control and hide dormant valve-position PID fields during inflation. Deflation retains its active PID display. Raw telemetry remains unchanged; unavailable pump error, integral and exact gains are clearly identified.

Failed NI reads retain driver error code, available and requested sample counts, and the reported partial-read count when exposed. This release adds evidence, without changing controller tuning, retry policy, task timing, calibration or firmware.

Focused tests passed on both branches, and layout audits and smoke checks passed. Default preserves its five clinical presets; Valinor preserves its Max pressure menu. Firmware remains qualified Default followup-292 or Valinor gauge-42. The active simulator session adopts the application only after it finishes and the existing idle gate passes.

Shared inflation coasting, startup tracking error, low-pressure pulse preservation and cross-cuff SysID remain under investigation. Diagnostic agreement is not independent arterial MAP validation.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
